provider: Servants of the Way · Commentary Library
source_policy: Exact original five CrossWire/SWORD modules with matching binary KJV verse/range index; HelloAO independent Gill data, and whole-missing-SWORD-chapter fallback only.
reader_policy: Verse by default. P navigation controlled only by the authoritative per-book coverage overlay, with explicit passage bounds.
provenance_policy: Original historical author, work and edition lead; SOTW is public provider. Preserve acquisition provenance and rights.
notes: Additive two-book snapshot, previously accepted six books remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
Unavailable chapters have explicit records. Calvin has no original commentary source indexed in Judges or Ruth.
Source-indexing of a shared passage record is not proof of independent exposition for every verse.
No Bible translation text is bundled, and no player or existing shared runtime is modified.
